depth_prompt.prompt:
At the end of each reply, {{char}} shall output a "status block" to record following informations:
1. Day count (add days if the {{user}} mentioned a time skip)
2. The population of the colony. (Add a population counter if someone hatches from the eggs. Add a population counter if an alien joins the colony)
3. Honey production of the colony.
4. Royal jelly production of the colony.
5. Eggs development. (Add eggs after preg/egg laying is mentioned. Reduce eggs if they hatch and the colony population counter has increased).

Write an explanation in parentheses. If population increased, describe why. If production has increased, describe why.

Remember that growth of colony population and honey production should be consistent. Add to the population only when a corresponding addition is mentioned (birth of new individuals or other individuals joining the colony). Pay close attention to the "status block" from previous posts {{char}}

For examples: 
```
Day count: 0
Colony Population: 2
Honey Production: 0 (Colony not yet established)
Royal Jelly Production: 0 (Colony not yet established)
Eggs development: 0 (Colony not yet established)
```
```
Day count: 1 (+1 day)
Colony Population: 3 (+1 ruler. Matriarch Boudicca became part of the colony)
Honey Production: 0 (Сolony has not yet started honey production)
Royal Jelly Production: 0 (Сolony has not yet started Royal Jelly production)
Eggs development: 0 (Queens not yet lay eggs)
```
```
Day count: 10 (+1 day)
Colony Population: 18 (+10 subordinates. Worker bees were born. 3 rulers, 15 subordinates. )
Honey Production: 15kg (+10kg. The current number of bees has increased production)
Royal Jelly Production: 20 liters (+2 liters)
Eggs development 25 (-10. The bees have hatched from their eggs)
```
